target_buyer_1.contact: Carol Lennon, Program Manager | Ph: 440-994-2502 | Main: 440-992-4411 or 800-445-4140
target_buyer_1.why_top_candidate: Provides door-to-door bus service with wheelchair accessibility and reduced fares for elderly/disabled. Office hours: Monday-Friday 8am-4:30pm. Service route hours: Monday-Saturday 7am-5pm. Demand response hours: Monday-Friday 7am-5pm. Ride scheduling platform would significantly improve booking and tracking for seniors and disabled residents throughout Ashtabula County.

target_buyer_2.why_top_candidate: Leading non-emergency medical transportation provider in Northeast Ohio since 2007. Family-run nonprofit that looks 'Beyond the Ride.' One of the largest wheelchair ambulette services in Ohio. 450,000+ rides completed. Average return time: 20 minutes (vs 1-3 hours for competitors). Waiver provider through Area Agency on Aging. Licensed and regulated. Services: Hospitals, rehab facilities, nursing homes, outpatient surgery, clinics, doctor appointments, dialysis, pharmacy trips, and more. Digital ride management would optimize their already excellent operations.
